big: India imports most of its crude oil. When oil rises, India pays more dollars. That widens the current account deficit and can weigh on the rupee.

lines: Who gains from a weaker rupee?
IT and pharma exporters earn dollars, so they gain. Domestic gold prices rise too. But FPI selling adds pressure on the rupee, while DII buying cushions equity markets.
